name: financial-model-builder
description: Build or audit formula-driven financial models for small and medium-sized businesses in English or Russian, including assumptions, sourced market inputs, unit economics, scenarios, sensitivity analysis, and client handoff materials.

interface.longDescription: Build or audit a small-business financial model in English or Russian. The workflow captures objectives and assumptions, prepares a client questionnaire, researches material market inputs, calculates unit economics, builds a formula-driven spreadsheet, compares scenarios, tests sensitivity, and prepares handoff materials. Results depend on the quality of the inputs and do not replace personalized investment, tax, accounting, or legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Build a financial model from my business assumptions.
Audit my spreadsheet model and identify errors.
Run scenario and sensitivity analysis for this business.

publication.release_notes: Initial bilingual release for building and auditing small-business financial models in English and Russian.

ru-RU.subtitle: Проверяемые финмодели
ru-RU.description: Создаёт и проверяет финансовые модели на русском или английском языке: исходные параметры, рыночные допущения, себестоимость, Excel-модель на формулах, сценарии, чувствительность и материалы для передачи заказчику. Результат зависит от качества исходных данных и не заменяет индивидуальную инвестиционную, налоговую, бухгалтерскую или юридическую консультацию.
